item.title: Amase-Jima wa Irokoi Zakari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Liaison
  • 発売日: 2023-12-22
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天瀬島は色恋ざかり
  • 英語名: Amase-Jima wa Irokoi Zakari

别名

  • Starry Garden

あらすじ

There’s an issue with the young ladies on this island.

The protagonist, Haruka Amase, was summoned to a warm, secluded island, which had nothing but the prestigious young ladies’ academy.

Upon instructions from his mother, the headmistress, he ends up living there for a while as a “living teaching material” for these young ladies who seem clueless about interacting with men.
